build_T2T_ViT_backbone: build a T2T-ViT backbone model with configurable embed dims and transformer layers for image feature extraction
create_T2TTransformerLayer: create a transformer layer with multihead attention and feedforward network supporting different input and embed dimensions
create_T2TModule: create a tokens-to-token module that progressively reduces image tokens using soft splitting and self-attention
generate_sinusoid_encoding: generate a sinusoidal position encoding table for a given number of positions and embedding dimensions
format_output_T2T_ViT: format T2T-ViT output as cls_token, featmap, avg_featmap, or raw token tensor based on out_type config
